conviction_note: The hunt found a beat that is likely but already expected, plus a small activist floor. The street (IFIS full-year PBT 23,664 against the company's 22,000) has already priced an upward revision from the public 91.5% H1 progress rate, and this name's last two Q3 prints were sold (-4.7% on a small raise in 2024, about -0.5% to -2% when the plan was held in 2025). So p_up is 52 on a 3.5 scale. The +0.5 findings sum is larger than the scaled +0.14 because the reaction history on this exact line (Q3 plus a small revision) argues against the fundamental read.

findings.finding: The nine-month pre-tax profit should clear both the IFIS Q3 path (21,660m) and probably the full-year plan (22,000m). H1 was already 20,140m (91.5% of plan, against 82.8% at the same point last year). The four stable segments earned about 8.0bn yen of segment profit in H1 alone. Q3 PBT was 2,633m in FY2025 and 1,718m in FY2024. So the release likely brings either an upward revision (plus a dividend rise under the 35% payout rule) or a held plan that implies a Q4 loss, as in FY2025. The street's 23,664m full-year number already prices most of an upward revision.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 FY2024 (2024-10-07, 15:00): net forecast raised 4.6% and dividend +4 yen. Close 1231 to 1173.5, -4.7%, reported as '修正幅小幅で出尽くし'. Q3 FY2025 (2025-10-06, 14:30): plan held at 99.7% net progress. Close-to-close -0.5% (1662.5 to 1655), about -2% from the release-day open. H1 FY2025 (raise of +10%, split, 優待 change): +3.4%. This year's Q1 and H1, with IFIS beats and no revision: +7.1% and +4.5%. Tosei revised at the Q3 print in 1 of the last 3 years (2024); in 2023 and 2025 it revised on 10/31 and 11/05 instead.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The progress rate is public, and consensus PBT sits 7.6% above the plan. What is not priced is the size of any revision and whether it comes now or in November. If the market had priced a large raise, the stock would not trade at 11x forward PE with 2,103 yen consensus target 22% above spot, and it would not have sold off after the last Q3 raise. Q3 PBT above about 2,500m (FY2025 level) would put the nine months at about 22,600m, above the full-year plan.

findings.finding: Activist Dalton Investments raised its stake to 6.07% (5,908,100 shares, obligation date 2026-07-06) by buying almost daily on the market from May to July. Its 保有目的 cites a December 2025 letter asking for capital-cost management and a review of all strategic options, including going private. Grantham Mayo has held over 5% since April 2026. This is a persistent bid and pressure for capital return; a 自己株式取得 alongside results is possible but not signalled. The company calls buybacks '機動的に検討' and none is running.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY2026 (2026-04-06), when Grantham's 5% report landed the same day: +7.1% (confounded with the beat). Earlier Q3 prints in 2025 came with buyback status reports, and the reactions were flat to negative.
findings.why_not_priced: The stake is public, so the holding itself is priced. Only the chance of a buyback or a payout change announced with this print is open. If the market expected one, the stock would not be trading below the July post-H1 level (1,792) with no run-up.
findings.independence: kabutan's EDINET summary of the same filing: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=8923&b=n202607130788 (same document). The capital-policy PDF https://www.toseicorp.co.jp/files/ir-policy-capital-04.pdf states a 35% payout and opportunistic buybacks.

findings.finding: Into the print, Tosei is down only 1.4% over 20 sessions. Over the same period real-estate peers fell 3.3% to 8.9% (Mitsui Fudosan -5.7%, Ichigo -3.3%, Nomura RE -8.9%, TOPIX RE ETF -6.6%), and on 2026-10-02, when peers lost 2.5-4.1%, Tosei was flat. So part of a good Q3 is already in the relative price.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no direct history. On 2026-09-02 the stock fell 5.3% against a 2-2.6% peer drop, so it takes sector beta with a lag.
findings.why_not_priced: This is a statement about what is priced, not an unpriced fact. It lowers the payoff on a beat. It is a proxy and sized small.

outside_window.finding: FY2026 is the final year of the 'Further Evolution 2026' mid-term plan. A new mid-term plan and the FY2027 guide are due with full-year results on 2027-01-13, and Tosei revised in November in two of the last three years (2025-11-05, 2024-11-25).

baseline_tension: Run-up -1.37% and lean -0.565 (margin-overhang prior on a tiny long balance) lean slightly negative. The findings lean slightly positive. The strongest positive the release could carry is a revision above the 23,664m consensus PBT, a dividend rise and a buyback under activist pressure. I looked for each: no pre-signal for any, and the consensus already prices a modest raise, so the net is close to a non-result.
